title: Sound Circle — Full Moon Sound Journey at Peninsula Hot Springs
summary: Deeply relaxing full moon sound journey at Peninsula Hot Springs Wellness Studio; followed by geothermal hot springs bathing. $150 all-inclusive: sound journey (approx 90 min); grounding with superfood balls and herbal tea; geothermal hot springs access from 12pm. Hosted by Sound Circle (Lucy Ennis)
